answer: No identity acts without a relic, and the jetty renews a relic only after a mirror has judged that many attested epochs of the identity's own work, as many as the berth already holds relics. A berth passes whole to every fork, so a clone cannot start a fresh count. An honest newcomer pays one epoch; the operator's thousandth identity pays a thousand of its own, and the fleet must run five hundred thousand epochs, none of them shareable.
